metadata.sampling_rule: one shared physical cycle per saved digit; exact 16-Group row lookup for each quantized level, followed by independent magnitude-adaptive multiplicative jitter

migration_contract: Each of 256 sheets must have Cycle=1..400 and Group_1..16; mismatch raises an error.
scope: Disjoint indices of an existing processed response library, under its existing alignment convention.
not_claimed: end-to-end holdout of raw measurements before source-workbook normalization
